notes.title: Balance patch and reduced price
notes.notes:
We have made various updates to improve game balance - this included changes of resource generation, unit attributes, and price/strength of skills (details below). This should bring the chances to win for each faction even closer. We continue to keep an eye for those that under/overperform. 


Balance updates

Changes (resource):
Corrupted resource generation  - Damage dealt/8, Damage received/16
Maharama resource generation - Death of allied unit reduces resource by 10

Changes (skills):
No Escape - new resource price 25 
Armor of faith - new resource price 25
Mirrored Doom - new resource price 15
Afterimage - new action points price 4
Barrier - added unlimited range
Shadow orb - new action points price 5

Reaper's Breath - new action points price 5, resource price 25

notes.title: ToC full release on 6.3.2022
notes.notes:
Full release of the Theater of Carnage is scheduled for Sunday 6th of March 2022. It is time to sharpen weapons and wit. All 4 factions are refined, each with their own unique flavor. And their champions are ready to enter the fray under your command.

notes.title: Full Release of ToC is just around the corner
notes.notes:
We are delighted to share that Theater Of Carnage is almost finished! All the factions and characters are completed. Now we are just working on final tune up and polishing.

More information about release date will be coming soon.
